text:
Leah M.: Heads up: Brightline just changed owners on 8 accounts via the marketplace intake. A couple of these have active POCs. We need a short incident reconciliation and an ROE tweak so this doesn't keep happening.

Diego R.: Which accounts? any demos at risk?

Leah M.: Quick excerpt: acct_4022 (POC, prev: sam@, new: nora@brightline), acct_4077 (demo scheduled, prev: leah@, new: nora@brightline).

Sam K.: If Brightline is in a named vertical carve, okay, but they should never flip owners without a 24h review and field confirmation.

Nora (Brightline): Sorry about the surprise. We followed the onboarding checklist and submitted the request; thought it would be a dry-run. We can pause outreach until you guys sign off.

Leah M.: Proposed immediate steps: 1) place a 24-hour hold on all SI-initiated owner changes; 2) add a co_sell_role field (SI_lead / Redwood_lead / Joint); 3) require an intake form checkbox for "customer-approved SI ownership".

Diego R.: Agreed. I can push a CRM queue rule that tags SI swaps as pending-review and creates a confirm task for partnerships + owner. If unconfirmed, revert ownership after 24h.

Sam K.: Also want a one-pager we can send to new SIs: do not change owner without intake + 24h review, define joint-play behavior, escalation contacts.

Nora (Brightline): We'll update our onboarding steps and mark the two live accounts as Joint. Brightline will not send invites to the demo until Redwood approves the script.

crm-bot: Note added on acct_4022 and acct_4077: "SI ownership change pending partnership review; 24h hold placed."

Leah M.: I'll draft the one-pager and drop it here today. Diego, ping me once the CRM rule is staged. Sam, please confirm which demos Redwood will keep the lead on.

Diego R.: Will stage the automation today and roll after Leah's doc. YAML trigger looks like: trigger: si_owner_change -> add_tag: pending-si-review -> notify: [partnerships, owner] -> create_task: confirm_si_swap -> revert_after: 24h.

Sam K.: I'll take ownership of the demo for acct_4077.

Leah M.: Thanks. Closing when doc + CRM rule are live.
